Hi Johnny and Michael,

My wife and I are interested in #16F at 222 Riverside. We're looking for a 1BR on Riverside or West End for a December 15 move-in and a 12-month lease.

We're both employed full-time with income well above 40x rent and strong credit, and our application documents are ready to go. We'd like to tour in the first half of November and can sign quickly.

A few questions:
1. Would the owner consider a December 15 start?
2. We'd want it unfurnished. Is that still an option?
3. What does the condo's application process look like, and how long does board approval usually take?

Thanks,
Mike Sovak

Hi Johnny, this is Mike Sovak. I just sent an inquiry on StreetEasy about 222 Riverside #16F. My wife and I are looking at a 12/15 move-in, unfurnished, and have everything ready to apply. Would love to set up a tour in early November if it's still around. Thanks!

Hi Michael, Mike Sovak here. Just reached out on StreetEasy about 222 Riverside #16F. We're targeting a 12/15 move-in, are fully qualified, and can move fast. Any idea how long the condo's board approval usually takes? Thanks!

Hello Mike! This is Johnny's assistant with Douglas Elliman. We can end anytime, but I know you were browsing some properties online in the Brooklyn area. Are you looking for yourself or for someone else?
Hi Douglas, we're mostly interested in the UWS. It is for me and my wife
Thanks for clarifying, Mike! The Upper West Side is a great area. Are you considering making a move anytime soon?
Sorry, your name isn't Douglas, it's your company name. We're targeting a move in date of 12/15.
You're absolutely right, my apologies for the confusion! Thanks for sharing that timeline. December 15th gives us a good window to work with. What price range are you considering?
While we don't deal with rentals, I'm here to help! When you are ready to start looking for that perfect home, I'll be ready!
I don't think I understand. Are you able to help me with the streeteasy listing I texted Johnny about?
